Construction is one failure-atomic lifecycle from allocation through field and delegation admission to exactly one publish or abort outcome. The canonical HIR carries one structural lifecycle plan and Deeplus MIR exposes the closed thirteen-operation construction/cleanup family with an explicit ConstructionTokenId specialization. Cleanup is reverse responsibility order, publication occurs once only after complete admission, and failure leaves no published partial owner.

Every one of the exact 638 Grammar productions has exactly one canonical disposition. Lossless CST retains tokens, trivia, recovery residue and production ownership; normalization to canonical AST is deterministic and receipt-bound; recovery nodes never enter canonical AST or HIR.

Statement boundaries and match-arm bodies and separators are chosen by closed parser-context algorithms. Transactional probes consume no input and emit no diagnostics on failure; delimiters and required children outrank contextual newline termination; parse receipts preserve every selected boundary decision.

STRICT_CANONICAL and ANALYSIS_RECOVERY share the same lossless recovery CST, bounded progress law and deterministic episode ordering. Recovery taint is transitive, cannot be cleared by a checker or formatter, and excludes recovered or analysis-only nodes from canonical AST, HIR, MIR, API digest, execution and conformance evidence.

Pratt dispatch is closed over exactly EXPRESSION, PREDICATE, SLICE_INDEX, TYPE, NON_FUNCTION_TYPE and UNIT. Parselet admission, stop sets and binding powers are goal-specific. Message-call operators are structured led parselets at rank 15 rather than generic postfix operators.

The scanner uses a closed lexical-goal and complete-token registry with declared priority, failure-atomic speculative probes, exact byte partitioning and explicit mode transitions. It never commits an incomplete token prefix or infers semantic checker responsibility from token shape.

Shorthand interpolation is owned by a closed scanner state machine. The scanner fixes only the token boundary and exact source partition; parser and checker retain path, type and availability responsibility, and malformed shorthand cannot materialize an admitted canonical AST.

A multiline string is one atomic scanner-stream envelope whose payload leaves partition bytes exactly once. Dedent uses the byte longest common indentation prefix of nonblank content lines; closer indentation is metadata only. Embedded token tapes are materialized lazily under the closed lexical goals and no partial payload is canonical.

A source carrier fixes exactly one role from library, executable and script and exactly one activation profile from stable and preview before parsing. The six role/profile pairs select the six roots; stable normalizes to CURRENT and preview to EXPLICIT_PREVIEW. A PreviewGate validates an already selected preview profile, commits dependencies atomically and never changes role, profile or root.

laws.law: Functions, methods, local functions, closures, and lambdas preserve value/context/witness/rest channels together with ownership, capture, cleanup, effects, errors, cancellation, suspension, isolation, call-right, and lifetime. Call admission resolves one declaration identity without return-type-directed overload selection and then checks positional, labeled, repeated, named-unfold, context, and using-evidence channels independently. An ordinary mut parameter is a callee-owned mutable local and is distinct from caller-place inout. Public parameter decomposition is explicit in the body; return and local ret keep distinct owners.

laws.law: Actors own isolated state and a mailbox with one mutating turn at a time. An omitted MailboxClause selects logical_unbounded_v1; #mailbox(capacity: N) selects bounded_reject_v1 and immediately returns ActorMessageError::mailboxFull when full. One-way message expressions have exact type Result<Unit, error ActorMessageError>; requests have exact immediate type Result<Reply<T>, error ActorMessageError> and the Reply is extracted before one-shot await. A successfully admitted Reply<T> carries the non-forgeable typed-HIR/module-API/MIR ReplyResponsibility descriptor with normalized result type, handler ErrorSet, cancellation axis, isolation owner, ReplyId, request correlation identity, and receiverClosedBeforeReply terminal failure. Module API records the ReplyId and correlation identity as per-value non-forgeable policy markers rather than concrete runtime identities. Spawn-created structured execution is instead Run<T>, is owned by the nearest ConcurId, and never carries actor correlation or transport responsibility. Rejection before enqueue commit retains moved owners and allocates no channel_sequence; commit transfers each owner exactly once and allocates a strictly increasing sequence in the exact sender/receiver/mailbox-profile FIFO key. Cancellation remains distinct before and after commit, request/reply remains correlated and single-terminal, Run and Reply are never implicitly interchangeable, and product execution remains NOT_RUN.

concur is the sole Stable lexical structured-concurrency owner and automatically parallelizes nothing; only spawn creates one ConcurRunId and Run<T>. await asyncInvocation executes under the current ExecutionId, while spawn asyncInvocation creates one owner-bound run after complete precommit evaluation. The initial concur-local #async lambda is nonescaping, admits only empty or proven reusable explicit copy capture, and is consumed only by local/nested-inward await or spawn; general escaping async literals remain Preview Design. task scope, task group and the mixed Task<T> handle are removed without compatibility aliases. RunGroup<T> is Preview Design nonactivatable and, if later activated, is an owner-bound homogeneous observation carrier rather than a second lifetime owner. Deeplus values keep semantic identity separate from storage, serialization, discriminant, ABI, and backend layout. Int is the checked signed 64-bit default, and absence uses ::none in an expected Option context or Option<T>::none explicitly. The current operator vocabulary, fixity, binding power, and associativity are closed. Arbitrary custom operators are not part of the language. Fixed existing-glyph conformance dispatch is Stable for exactly thirteen unary, binary-arithmetic, equality, and total-order roles through nine Prelude Trait roots under intrinsic reservation plus one left-owner DIRECT_GLOBAL conformance with no conversion, order ranking, fallback, or runtime relookup. Derived inequality, ordering projections, and compound assignment create no independent witness; range remains a closed intrinsic carrier rule rather than a conformance hook. Stable ternary evaluates one Bool condition and exactly one lazy arm and joins type, ownership, effect, error, cancellation, place, and cleanup responsibility without synthesizing a Union. Map literals evaluate direct entries and Map unfolds once from left to right, replace duplicate keys deterministically inside one failure-atomic plan, and publish no partial Map. Basic String interpolation preselects deterministic synchronous Display witnesses, evaluates holes once in source order, and grants no hidden locale, provider, serialization, parsing, or redaction authority; colon format-spec semantics remain DEFERRED_PRODUCT_HANDOFF. Attached NumericArray transpose is a semantic nonowning, owner-bounded read-only coordinate view with no implicit element copy, language-observable allocation authority, mutation, adjoint, or isolation crossing; backend representation remains unselected. Built-in ordered sequences and default NumericArray axes are one-based, bounded lists preserve declared coordinates, slices preserve coordinates and owner provenance, and [] is activated only by the closed built-in carrier matrix.

Flow facts live in Phi and never mutate declared types. Exact typed alternatives are refutable inside closed Union pattern owners; the existing closed-Union-only `is`/`!is` forms evaluate the subject and stored injection identity once and produce complementary Bool edge facts. `T where > rhs` is exact sugar for `T where this > rhs`, while `T in a..b` and `T in a..<b` are inclusive and upper-exclusive interval refinements; bare `T > rhs` is not a type surface. A monotone chained binder Pattern such as `0 <= value <= 100` binds the match subject once and exposes the corresponding refinement fact in its arm; mixed direction rejects. Every admitted def#guard exports one verified finite-R0 GuardSummaryV1. A direct exact call over stable actual places may substitute that summary once and add P/not(P) to the true/false Phi edges without changing declared types, producing a proof object, or reevaluating the predicate. Stored Bool values, wrappers, dynamic dispatch, unstable actuals, and guarded-arm exhaustiveness gain no fact. Durable facts die on assignment, aliasing mutation, exclusive borrow, escape/capture, consume, suspension, or a may-mutate/may-consume call. Float complements remain logical negation and are not algebraically strengthened across NaN. Union formation requires a finite pairwise DISJOINT proof, and pattern probes commit ownership only after structural success and a true admitted guard. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

Exactly ClassDecl, TraitDecl, EnumDecl, TypeAliasDecl, SchemaDecl, ActorDecl, ActorProtocolDecl, TypestateResourceDecl, and BitfieldDecl are type-producing top-level visibility owners. In every Stable or Preview library, executable, and script root they require an explicit public/common/private domain; omission is rejected and produces zero admitted HIR type identities. Every other top-level owner carrying TopLevelVisibility? defaults an omitted word to private. Wider API residue cannot expose a narrower identity, common is never external or re-exported, and public requires a separately admitted export or module interface.

Structured ~ and :~ are Pratt led parselets at rank 15; ~ is left-associative and :~ is terminal and nonassociative. A comma after a nested tilde call requires explicit grouping. There is no message payload aggregate or Tuple/Record-to-formal projection. :~ statically selects one actor on/request operation with no ordinary fallback, performs immediate failure-atomic mailbox admission, and never implicitly suspends or retries. on and request with the same selector and canonical call shape are rejected early, and actor transport is forbidden in defer. Semantic P0 remains 0, the existing feature P1 set remains exactly 22 OPEN, and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

laws.law: Arbitrary glyph/fixity/precedence custom operators are not a Deeplus feature. The Prelude roots are UnaryPlus, UnaryMinus, Add<Rhs>, Subtract<Rhs>, Multiply<Rhs>, Divide<Rhs>, Remainder<Rhs>, Eq<Rhs>, and Ord<Rhs>; != is derived from Eq and the four ordering glyphs from one Ord.compare result. Compound +=,-=,*=,/=,%= is derived from the corresponding binary operation and exact assignment admission and creates no independent witness. Every non-intrinsic expression uses at most one direct-global left-owner conformance with intrinsic reservation and no conversion, source order, fallback, specialization, alternate route, or runtime relookup. Division and remainder faults raise ArithmeticDefect before commit. The Stable &&/||/^^/~~ family remains closed built-in pointwise logical behavior and supplies no user-carrier hook. Stable `static { ... }` retains its exact function-body prologue contract. The accepted Trait shared-design surface uses type/conforms, repeated conforms, derives, supports auto/by auto under a closed policy, qualified Trait::member, and conform blocks while preserving lowercase via, as-name identity, and associated projections. Semantic P0 remains 0 and the existing feature P1 set remains exactly 22 OPEN; every product lane remains NOT_RUN.
